title: Tlow: Flow-based Item Tokenizer for Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24176v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Item tokenizer encodes semantic embeddings into token IDs to replace the randomly assigned item IDs used in traditional recommendation models, fundamentally addressing the problems of excessive parameters and cold starts. However, the most common tokenizer, RQ-VAE, suffers from low decoding efficiency due to the inherent dependencies among its codebooks. Meanwhile, efficient independent tokenizers such as optimized product quantization (OPQ) still struggle with dimensional correlations and distribution complexity of semantic embeddings. In this work, we propose a f\underline{low}-based item \underline{T}okenizer (Tlow) to transform raw semantic embeddings into a latent space where embeddings conform to a unified standard normal distribution, achieving dual advantages of dimensional independence and distributional simplicity. Independent tokenization performed on these latent embeddings yields semantically clear token IDs. Additionally,

translated_title: Tlow：基于流的物品分词器用于推荐系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24176v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：物品分词器将语义嵌入编码为令牌ID，以取代传统推荐模型中随机分配的物品ID，从根本上解决了参数过多和冷启动问题。然而，最常见的分词器RQ-VAE由于其码本间的固有依赖性，存在解码效率低的问题。同时，高效的独立分词器，如优化乘积量化（OPQ），仍难以应对语义嵌入的维度相关性和分布复杂性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于流的物品分词器（Tlow），将原始语义嵌入转换到一个潜在空间，其中嵌入符合统一的标准正态分布，从而同时实现维度独立性和分布简单性的双重优势。对这些潜在嵌入进行独立分词，可生成语义清晰的令牌ID。此外，
tldr: 本文提出Tlow分词器，通过流模型将语义嵌入转换为标准正态分布，实现维度独立和分布简化，从而高效生成语义清晰的令牌ID，解决推荐系统中现有分词器的解码效率和分布复杂性难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Tlow, a flow-based item tokenizer that transforms semantic embeddings into a standard normal distribution, achieving dimensional independence and distributional simplicity for efficient generation of semantically clear token IDs, addressing decoding efficiency and distribution complexity issues in existing tokenizers.
